chapters.title: A New Routine
chapters.intro: The diagnosis came three weeks ago. The word is still strange in your mouth: plural. A system. Sam always thought the gaps in their memory were just stress. Now there are names in the journal that aren't Sam's handwriting. Maybe that's... okay? Maybe we can work together.

chapters.title: Clocking In
chapters.intro: Bills don't care about headspace. There's a new job — or a new semester — and everyone needs to figure out who's good at what. Some of us love deadlines. Some of us really, really don't.

chapters.title: Out in the World
chapters.intro: Errands. Appointments. Phone calls. The outside world runs on scripts nobody gave us. Time to write our own.

chapters.title: People We Love
chapters.intro: Friends have noticed that 'you' sometimes like different foods, laugh at different jokes, answer to a slightly different voice. Connection is scary. It's also the point.

chapters.title: Hard Days
chapters.intro: Not every day is a good day. Some days the ground shifts. But the system has grown. There are more hands to hold now.

chapters.title: Home Within
chapters.intro: The headspace feels different lately. Warmer. Doors that used to be locked are open. It's time to build a life everyone can live in.

ev_morning.name: The Morning Routine
ev_morning.intro: The alarm goes off. Then the snooze. Then the second snooze. Who's up first?

nodes.text: The alarm is blaring. Someone needs to actually get out of bed.

choices.label: Push through and get up
choices.ok: Feet on the cold floor. You're up!
choices.fail: Back under the blanket. Ten more minutes turn into thirty.

choices.label: Gentle self-talk
choices.ok: 'Just sit up. That's all.' It works.
choices.fail: The inner monologue argues with itself. Loudly.

nodes.text: Breakfast. The fridge holds: one egg, mystery leftovers, and oat milk.

choices.label: Improvise something tasty
choices.ok: Egg fried rice! From leftovers! Genius.
choices.fail: It's... edible. Mostly.

choices.label: Check the meal plan
choices.ok: Jo left a note: 'oatmeal, cabinet 2.' Perfect.
choices.fail: The meal plan is from two weeks ago.

nodes.text: Did we take our meds? Nobody remembers. The pill organizer is right there.

choices.label: Check carefully
choices.ok: Tuesday's slot is full. Meds taken, logged.
choices.fail: Wait, is today Tuesday or Wednesday?

nodes.text: Out the door! ...Where are the keys?

choices.label: Retrace steps
choices.ok: In the fridge. Next to the oat milk. Of course.
choices.fail: Found them after 15 minutes. In your pocket.

choices.label: Ask inside
choices.ok: A small voice: 'I put them in the shoe!' Thanks, Pip.
choices.fail: Nobody's answering. The headspace is sleepy.

ev_morning.outro: You made it out the door. Late-ish, but in one piece. Someone leaves a note in the journal: 'Good job, team.'

ev_grocery.name: The Grocery Run
ev_grocery.intro: The fridge is empty. Time to brave the supermarket on a Saturday.

nodes.text: Making the list. Everyone has requests. Pip wants dino nuggets. Toby wants vegetables.

choices.label: Organize by aisle
choices.ok: A beautiful list, sorted by section. Dino nuggets included.
choices.fail: The list just says 'food??'

choices.label: Hold a quick system vote
choices.ok: Compromise: nuggets AND broccoli.
choices.fail: Everyone talks at once. Headache incoming.

nodes.text: The store is packed. Bright lights, beeping, someone's kid is screaming.

choices.label: Ground and breathe
choices.ok: Headphones on, deep breath. It's manageable.
choices.fail: Everything is too loud. You hide in the cereal aisle for a bit.

choices.label: Power through fast
choices.ok: In and out like a speedrun.
choices.fail: Your cart has a wobbly wheel. Of course it does.

nodes.text: The thing you came for is out of stock.

choices.label: Find a substitute
choices.ok: Different brand, same vibe. Crisis averted.
choices.fail: You stare at the empty shelf for a long time.

nodes.text: Self-checkout: 'Unexpected item in bagging area.'

choices.label: Stay calm and call for help
choices.ok: The attendant fixes it with a smile.
choices.fail: You apologize to the machine. Twice.

choices.label: Figure it out
choices.ok: Re-scan, re-bag, done.
choices.fail: The machine wins this round.

ev_grocery.outro: Bags in hand. Nobody fronted alone today, and the trip felt lighter for it.

ev_first_day.name: First Day at the New Job
ev_first_day.intro: New job. New people. New coffee machine. Let's make a good first impression — with whoever is fronting.

nodes.text: Introductions around the office. So many names.

choices.label: Be friendly and chatty
choices.ok: Everyone seems to like you. Mira is thrilled.
choices.fail: You call someone 'Dave.' Their name is Karen.

choices.label: Write names down
choices.ok: A tidy little seating chart in your notebook.
choices.fail: Your notes say 'tall guy?' and 'plant lady.'

nodes.text: Onboarding training: a 2-hour video about the filing system.

choices.label: Lock in
choices.ok: Taking notes, absorbing everything.
choices.fail: You lose time. Someone else watched it, but their notes are illegible.

nodes.text: Your manager hands you a task with vague instructions.

choices.label: Ask clarifying questions
choices.ok: Clear expectations. Great start.
choices.fail: You nod a lot. You have no idea what she meant.

choices.label: Make a plan
choices.ok: Broken into steps. Doable.
choices.fail: The plan has a plan. Paralysis.

nodes.text: End of day. You're exhausted and someone invites you to after-work drinks.

choices.label: Politely decline
choices.ok: 'Next time!' Boundaries feel good.
choices.fail: You say yes, then regret it all the way there.

choices.label: Go, briefly
choices.ok: Thirty minutes, one soda, new friends.
choices.fail: Small talk overload.

ev_first_day.outro: First day: survived. Ivy would probably say 'adequate.' From Ivy, that's a compliment.

ev_team_meeting.name: The Big Team Meeting
ev_team_meeting.intro: The quarterly meeting. Your project is on the agenda.

nodes.text: Preparing your talking points the night before.

choices.label: Outline it all
choices.ok: Bullet points, color-coded.
choices.fail: You make slides about making slides.

choices.label: Make it engaging
choices.ok: A great story to frame the data.
choices.fail: Too many memes.

nodes.text: The meeting starts. You feel a switch coming on — someone wants to come forward.

choices.label: Smooth handoff
choices.ok: A seamless co-front. Nobody notices a thing.
choices.fail: A few seconds of fog. 'Sorry, could you repeat that?'

choices.label: Stay present
choices.ok: You hold steady through it.
choices.fail: You zone out during your own section.

nodes.text: Your turn to present.

choices.label: Speak with confidence
choices.ok: Clear, calm, convincing.
choices.fail: Your voice wobbles. But you finish.

nodes.text: A coworker challenges your numbers. Loudly.

choices.label: Stand firm
choices.ok: 'Let's look at the data together.' Captain would be proud.
choices.fail: Your face goes hot. You concede a point you were right about.

choices.label: Recall the details
choices.ok: Page 3, figure 2. You were right.
choices.fail: You know the answer. It's just... somewhere else in the system.

ev_team_meeting.outro: Your manager emails afterward: 'Great work today.' Somebody inside does a little victory dance.

ev_exam.name: Finals Week
ev_exam.intro: An exam in the morning. Not everybody took the same notes. Not everybody went to the same lectures.

nodes.text: Pooling knowledge: who remembers what from class?

choices.label: Hold a headspace study group
choices.ok: Quill had chapter 3, Echo had chapter 5. Together it's complete!
choices.fail: Half the system was 'in' for different lectures. Gaps everywhere.

choices.label: Reorganize the notes
choices.ok: One master study guide, merged from everyone's handwriting.
choices.fail: Four different handwritings. One of them is crayon.

nodes.text: Late-night cramming. The brain is mush.

choices.label: Push through
choices.ok: It's clicking now.
choices.fail: You read the same paragraph nine times.

choices.label: Take a real break
choices.ok: Snack, stretch, water. Back stronger.
choices.fail: The break lasted three hours. Oops.

nodes.text: Exam room. The first question looks unfamiliar.

choices.label: Breathe and skip ahead
choices.ok: Question 2 is easy. Confidence builds.
choices.fail: Panic rising. You stare at the clock.

choices.label: Think creatively
choices.ok: You work it out from first principles.
choices.fail: Creative answer. Wrong, though.

nodes.text: Final essay question.

choices.label: Write it out
choices.ok: Quill takes the pen and the words just flow.
choices.fail: You run out of time mid-sentence.

choices.label: Structured answer
choices.ok: Intro, three points, conclusion. Textbook.
choices.fail: Your outline was great. The essay never happened.

nodes.text: Pencils down. Walking out of the exam hall.

choices.label: Celebrate!
choices.ok: Bubble tea with classmates.
choices.fail: You go home and stare at the ceiling. That's fine too.

ev_exam.outro: Whatever the grade, you did it as a team. That's worth more than an A.

ev_doctor.name: The Doctor's Appointment
ev_doctor.intro: An appointment you've rescheduled three times. Today's the day.

nodes.text: Booking was the easy part. Getting there on time is another.

choices.label: Plan the route
choices.ok: Bus at 9:12, arrive 9:40. Done.
choices.fail: You arrive at the wrong building.

nodes.text: The waiting room. Fluorescent lights. Clipboard forms.

choices.label: Fill out the forms
choices.ok: Every box checked. Even the weird ones.
choices.fail: 'Previous surgeries?' Nobody knows. Some memories aren't accessible.

choices.label: Self-soothe
choices.ok: Fidget toy in pocket. Steady breathing.
choices.fail: Your leg won't stop bouncing.

nodes.text: The doctor asks about your symptoms. You only partially remember.

choices.label: Check the system notes
choices.ok: Echo kept a symptom log. Dates, details, everything.
choices.fail: The notes are in three different apps.

choices.label: Advocate for yourself
choices.ok: 'I need you to take this seriously.' They do.
choices.fail: You say 'it's probably nothing' and immediately regret it.

nodes.text: The doctor gives you a lot of instructions very quickly.

choices.label: Ask them to write it down
choices.ok: A printed sheet. Excellent.
choices.fail: You forget everything by the parking lot.

choices.label: Focus hard
choices.ok: You catch every detail.
choices.fail: Two out of five instructions retained.

ev_doctor.outro: Appointment done. You treat yourselves to something nice on the way home. Everyone agrees: worth it.

ev_bank_call.name: Calling the Bank
ev_bank_call.intro: There's a charge on your account you didn't make. Or... did someone else in here make it?

nodes.text: First: an internal investigation. Did anyone buy a $40 art set?

choices.label: Ask around inside
choices.ok: Wren confesses: 'it was for the system!' Fair. But the other charge is real fraud.
choices.fail: Nobody answers. Suspicious silence.

choices.label: Check the receipts
choices.ok: Art set: Wren. Mystery $200: definitely not us.
choices.fail: Receipts are a mess.

nodes.text: You dial. The hold music is a single song on loop.

choices.label: Wait patiently
choices.ok: Forty minutes. You make it with grace.
choices.fail: You hang up at minute 38. Have to call again.

choices.label: Do something meanwhile
choices.ok: You doodle an entire comic while waiting.
choices.fail: You get distracted and miss when they pick up.

nodes.text: The agent asks for security questions. 'What was your first pet's name?'

choices.label: Ask the memory holders
choices.ok: Ellis knows. 'Biscuit.' Correct!
choices.fail: Three different alters give three different answers.

nodes.text: The agent says they can't help and wants to end the call.

choices.label: Stand your ground
choices.ok: Marisol takes over. 'Escalate this, please.' Charge reversed.
choices.fail: You thank them for not helping and hang up.

choices.label: Stay calm and persistent
choices.ok: Polite, firm, repeated. They give in.
choices.fail: Your voice cracks. You'll try again tomorrow.

ev_bank_call.outro: Fraud reported, card replaced. Wren gets to keep the art set. Everyone agrees that's fair.

ev_lost_time.name: Where Did Tuesday Go?
ev_lost_time.intro: You 'wake up' and it's Thursday. The last thing you remember is Tuesday afternoon.

nodes.text: First, orientation. Where are you? What day is it?

choices.label: Ground yourself
choices.ok: Feet on floor, check the phone. Thursday, 3pm. Safe at home.
choices.fail: Everything feels far away for a while.

choices.label: Look for clues
choices.ok: Dishes done, plants watered. Someone took care of things.
choices.fail: Clues are confusing. Why is there a kite?

nodes.text: Check messages. Did anyone reply to anyone?

choices.label: Read carefully
choices.ok: Someone answered work emails. Professionally, even!
choices.fail: Someone texted your friend 'lol ok' in all caps.

choices.label: Smooth things over
choices.ok: A quick 'sorry, been a weird week!' and everything's fine.
choices.fail: Your apology is more confusing than the original text.

nodes.text: Leave a note in the journal for whoever was out.

choices.label: Write a kind note
choices.ok: 'Thank you for handling things. Can we talk?' A reply appears the next day.
choices.fail: The note comes out a bit accusatory. Oops.

choices.label: Set up a shared calendar
choices.ok: Now everyone can log what they did. Fewer surprises.
choices.fail: The calendar app wants a subscription.

ev_lost_time.outro: Lost time is still scary. But this time, someone left the lights on for you.

ev_birthday.name: A Friend's Birthday Party
ev_birthday.intro: Your friend Alex is turning 30. There will be people. Many people.

nodes.text: What gift do you get?

choices.label: Make something handmade
choices.ok: A painted mug. Alex will love it.
choices.fail: The glue isn't dry. You're holding it in a bag very carefully.

choices.label: Remember what they wanted
choices.ok: That book they mentioned in June! Perfect.
choices.fail: You get a gift card. It's fine.

nodes.text: Arriving at the party. Music, voices, too many faces.

choices.label: Find your friend
choices.ok: Alex hugs you immediately. You relax.
choices.fail: You stand by the snacks for 20 minutes.

choices.label: Take a moment outside first
choices.ok: A breath of fresh air. Ready now.
choices.fail: You almost go home. Almost.

nodes.text: A party game starts! Charades.

choices.label: Go all in
choices.ok: Your interpretive dance of 'Jaws' gets a standing ovation.
choices.fail: Nobody guesses 'toaster.'

choices.label: Cheer from the side
choices.ok: Best hype person in the room.
choices.fail: You feel left out.

nodes.text: Someone you don't know asks, 'Didn't we meet last week?' You have no memory of it.

choices.label: Play it cool
choices.ok: 'Oh yeah! Remind me your name?' Smooth.
choices.fail: You panic and say 'I have a twin.'

choices.label: Ask inside
choices.ok: Nova: 'That's Jordan! We talked about frogs.'
choices.fail: Silence from the headspace.

nodes.text: It's getting late and your social battery is at 2%.

choices.label: Leave gracefully
choices.ok: Goodbyes, hugs, home. Perfect timing.
choices.fail: Irish exit. You'll text an apology.

ev_birthday.outro: Alex texts later: 'So glad you came!! ❤'. The whole system feels warm.

ev_disclosure.name: Telling a Friend
ev_disclosure.intro: Alex deserves to know. The system has voted — mostly yes. Today you're going to tell them.

nodes.text: How do you even start this conversation?

choices.label: Write a script
choices.ok: Quill drafts it. Clear, honest, hopeful.
choices.fail: Fourteen drafts. None feel right.

choices.label: Speak from the heart
choices.ok: You decide to just be honest. That's enough.
choices.fail: Your mind goes blank.

nodes.text: Sitting across from Alex. Heart pounding.

choices.label: Stay grounded
choices.ok: Steady hands. Steady voice. You say it.
choices.fail: You almost switch out mid-sentence. You push through, shakily.

nodes.text: Alex is quiet. Then: 'So... is that why you sometimes like olives and sometimes don't?'

choices.label: Laugh and explain
choices.ok: 'Yes! Benny hates olives.' Alex laughs too.
choices.fail: Your laugh comes out weird. Awkward pause.

choices.label: Share resources
choices.ok: You show them a page from a plurality resource. They read it carefully.
choices.fail: You info-dump for 30 minutes.

nodes.text: Alex asks: 'Can I meet... the others?'

choices.label: Let someone say hi
choices.ok: Pip waves shyly. Alex waves back. Pip is delighted.
choices.fail: Nobody wants to come out. That's okay — next time.

choices.label: Set a gentle boundary
choices.ok: 'Maybe someday. Not today.' Alex says, 'Of course.'
choices.fail: You feel pressured. You end the conversation early.

ev_disclosure.outro: Alex hugs you. 'Thank you for trusting me. All of you.' The headspace is brighter tonight.

ev_date.name: A First Date
ev_date.intro: You matched with someone cute. There's a coffee date on Saturday. Several alters have opinions about this.

nodes.text: What do you wear? The closet has... range.

choices.label: Put an outfit together
choices.ok: Cozy but cute. Everyone approves.
choices.fail: Four outfits on the bed. Running late.

nodes.text: The conversation starts. They seem nice!

choices.label: Be charming
choices.ok: They laugh at your jokes. Real laughs.
choices.fail: You overshare about your houseplants.

choices.label: Listen attentively
choices.ok: You ask great follow-up questions.
choices.fail: You keep losing the thread.

nodes.text: They ask, 'So what are you like?' That's... a complicated question.

choices.label: Answer honestly-ish
choices.ok: 'I contain multitudes.' They smile. Maybe someday you'll explain.
choices.fail: You freeze. 'Um. Normal?'

choices.label: Turn it into a fun story
choices.ok: A charming answer about your many hobbies. All true!
choices.fail: Very confusing story.

nodes.text: Wrapping up. Do you want a second date?

choices.label: Check in with the system
choices.ok: Unanimous-ish 'yes!' You ask, they say yes too.
choices.fail: Internal debate drags on. You say 'I'll text you.'

ev_date.outro: Whatever happens next, the system learned something: you're allowed to want good things.

ev_trigger.name: An Unexpected Trigger
ev_trigger.intro: A smell. A song. Something small, and suddenly the world tilts. The front feels shaky.

nodes.text: The panic is rising. You need to get somewhere safer.

choices.label: Move to a quiet place
choices.ok: A bench outside, away from the noise.
choices.fail: Your legs feel like jelly. You sit on the floor right there.

choices.label: Ground in place
choices.ok: Cold water bottle in your hand. Five things you can see.
choices.fail: It's hard to breathe. Keep trying.

nodes.text: Someone inside needs to come forward — someone who can handle this.

choices.label: Let a protector front
choices.ok: A calm presence steps up. 'I've got us.'
choices.fail: The front is fuzzy. Several people hovering, nobody fully in.

choices.label: Reach out to someone safe
choices.ok: You text Alex: 'Rough moment.' They call immediately.
choices.fail: You type and delete the message five times.

nodes.text: The worst has passed. Now: what do the littles need?

choices.label: Comfort the little ones
choices.ok: Soft blanket, cartoons, a favorite plushie. Safe.
choices.fail: Pip is crying in the headspace. It'll take time.

choices.label: Reassure the whole system
choices.ok: 'We're safe. It's over. It's today, not then.'
choices.fail: Some alters aren't ready to listen yet.

nodes.text: Later: make a note for the therapist and for the system.

choices.label: Log it carefully
choices.ok: Trigger noted, coping skills that worked noted.
choices.fail: You don't want to think about it yet. That's okay.

choices.label: Write it out
choices.ok: Quill writes a poem about it. Something heavy becomes something held.
choices.fail: The words won't come today.

ev_trigger.outro: Hard days end, too. You got through this one together. Rest now.

ev_therapy.name: Therapy Session
ev_therapy.intro: Weekly therapy. Today, the therapist wants to try talking with more of the system.

nodes.text: Getting there with enough spoons left to actually talk.

choices.label: Plan the day lightly
choices.ok: Nothing else scheduled. Smart.
choices.fail: You booked a dentist appointment right before. Why.

nodes.text: The therapist asks who's present today.

choices.label: Check in internally
choices.ok: 'Sam is fronting, Ellis and Sage are close.' Clear and honest.
choices.fail: Blurry. 'Uh... us? Someone?'

choices.label: Let the right person front
choices.ok: Ellis steps forward. He's ready to talk about the hard stuff.
choices.fail: A switch doesn't quite happen.

nodes.text: A hard topic comes up.

choices.label: Stay with the feeling
choices.ok: It hurts, but it moves through. Progress.
choices.fail: You change the subject to the therapist's nice plant.

choices.label: Use art to express it
choices.ok: You draw what you can't say. The therapist nods.
choices.fail: You scribble and then scribble over it.

nodes.text: Homework time: improve inner communication this week.

choices.label: Set up a system meeting
choices.ok: A weekly 'headspace meeting' is planned. Everyone's invited.
choices.fail: You agree, but nobody remembers to do it.

choices.label: Make a communication board
choices.ok: A whiteboard on the fridge. Messages for each other.
choices.fail: The whiteboard markers are dry.

ev_therapy.outro: Therapy is hard work. Everyone gets a nap afterward. Earned.

ev_family_dinner.name: Family Dinner
ev_family_dinner.intro: A holiday dinner with family. They don't know. Or they half-know and don't believe it.

nodes.text: Preparing for the visit. Boundaries need to be planned in advance.

choices.label: Decide your limits
choices.ok: Two hours max. An exit phrase ready. A friend on standby.
choices.fail: 'I'll just play it by ear.' Famous last words.

choices.label: Rehearse with the system
choices.ok: Captain volunteers for the hard conversations.
choices.fail: Everyone's nervous. Nobody wants to go.

nodes.text: A relative makes a comment about how you 'used to be more fun.'

choices.label: Let it roll off
choices.ok: You smile and change the subject. It doesn't stick.
choices.fail: It stings more than you expected.

choices.label: Respond with humor
choices.ok: 'I'm a lot of fun. Ask any of me.' Your cousin snorts with laughter.
choices.fail: Nobody gets the joke.

nodes.text: The table gets loud. Old arguments resurface.

choices.label: Hold steady
choices.ok: You don't take the bait. Calm in the storm.
choices.fail: You feel yourself slipping back. Getting younger.

choices.label: Step away
choices.ok: 'Just getting some air.' A walk around the block.
choices.fail: You get cornered in the kitchen.

nodes.text: Someone asks directly: 'Is this about that multiple personality thing?'

choices.label: Calmly correct
choices.ok: 'It's called DID. And I'm happy to talk about it another time.'
choices.fail: You stumble over the words.

choices.label: Set a boundary
choices.ok: 'That's not up for discussion today.' Firm and kind.
choices.fail: You get pulled into a debate.

nodes.text: Time to go home.

choices.label: Leave on your terms
choices.ok: Right on schedule. Hugs where wanted.
choices.fail: You stay two hours longer than planned.

choices.label: Decompress on the drive
choices.ok: Loud music, windows down, deep breaths.
choices.fail: Silent drive. A lot to process.

ev_family_dinner.outro: You made it through. Family is complicated. Your system is your family too, and they were with you all night.

ev_moving.name: Moving Day
ev_moving.intro: A new apartment! With a bedroom that has room for a blanket fort AND a desk. But first: moving.

nodes.text: Packing up. Whose box is whose?

choices.label: Label everything
choices.ok: Color-coded boxes for every room. Bolt is so happy.
choices.fail: Every box says 'STUFF.'

choices.label: Pack fast
choices.ok: Done by noon!
choices.fail: A box breaks. Mugs everywhere.

nodes.text: The movers are late. And rude.

choices.label: Handle it firmly
choices.ok: Captain takes the phone. They're there in 20 minutes.
choices.fail: You end up carrying the couch yourself.

choices.label: Stay patient
choices.ok: Deep breaths. Snack break while you wait.
choices.fail: Frustration bubbles over.

nodes.text: Heavy lifting time.

choices.label: Lift with your legs
choices.ok: Atlas fronts. Everything moved in record time.
choices.fail: Your back will remember this.

nodes.text: Unpacking: making the new space feel like home for everyone.

choices.label: Decorate thoughtfully
choices.ok: A shelf for Pip's toys, Wren's art on the walls, Juniper's plants by the window.
choices.fail: Everything's in a pile. It's a start.

choices.label: Make a cozy corner
choices.ok: A soft corner for hard days. Everyone loves it.
choices.fail: Too tired to finish today.

nodes.text: The first night in the new place.

choices.label: Celebrate together
choices.ok: Pizza on the floor. Every alter gets a slice — metaphorically.
choices.fail: You fall asleep on a mattress with no sheets. Honestly? Great.

ev_moving.outro: New home. New start. The headspace has a new room too — you're not sure who built it, but it's lovely.

ev_our_day.name: Our Day
ev_our_day.intro: A whole day, planned together, where everyone gets a turn. Breakfast with Toby, art with Wren, a walk with Bramble, games with Theo. Is it possible?

nodes.text: Morning: planning the schedule so everyone gets time.

choices.label: Build the perfect schedule
choices.ok: Every hour accounted for, with breaks!
choices.fail: Too many people want 2pm.

choices.label: Hold a headspace meeting
choices.ok: Everyone gets a say. Even the quiet ones.
choices.fail: The meeting takes all morning.

nodes.text: Midday: a smooth series of switches.

choices.label: Graceful handoffs
choices.ok: Switch, switch, switch — like a relay race.
choices.fail: Someone gets stuck in front longer than planned.

choices.label: Stay aware and co-con
choices.ok: Everyone stays co-conscious. Nobody loses time.
choices.fail: A few gaps, but nothing big.

nodes.text: Afternoon: a creative project the whole system works on.

choices.label: Make a system mural
choices.ok: Everyone paints a piece. It's chaotic and beautiful.
choices.fail: Paint everywhere. Worth it.

nodes.text: Evening: a walk at sunset.

choices.label: Walk and talk
choices.ok: Bramble narrates the trees. Kit chases a leaf.
choices.fail: It rains. You dance in it anyway.

choices.label: Quiet reflection
choices.ok: Sage leads a gratitude moment. Everyone shares one thing.
choices.fail: Peaceful, even if your mind wanders.

nodes.text: Night: writing the day down in the system journal.

choices.label: Everyone writes a line
choices.ok: Thirty-four handwritings on one page. A family portrait in ink.
choices.fail: Only a few write. The rest draw hearts.

ev_our_day.outro: You are many. You are one. You are a team. Thank you for playing — and the story keeps going, one day at a time.
